category.leaf: 女童中长款连帽轻薄棉衣

description: 中长连帽版型显瘦挡风，轻量横绗棉服，多色可选秋冬外穿

styleLock.backgroundSystem: cream studio field #FAF6F1 and pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, pastel tinted panels #F5DDE0 / #DDF0E4 / #EAE4F5 for info shots, soft blurred autumn outdoor greenery for lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow, warm 5000K daylight for outdoor scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cream backdrop paper and light birch-toned flat surface
styleLock.typography: modern rounded sans-serif, single accent color per screen
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line outline icons in charcoal #2B2B2E, one accent per icon
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment, consistent garment scale across the set, hanger-flat and on-body presentations share the same proportions
noDrift: no adult models or recognizable child faces
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm kidswear outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream #FAF6F1, charcoal #2B2B2E, blush pink accent #F5DDE0 and mint secondary #DDF0E4; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示整件棉衣轮廓

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment displayed front-facing on an invisible form, straight-on eye-level view, hood and sleeves fully inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial kidswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no child model, no face, no props, no hanger hooks visible, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：p1 户外红棉服主视觉+卖点文案；p2 街拍场景+版型主张；p3 背面全身+口袋放大圈；p4 帽子/拉链两组圆形细节放大+面料特写与成分标注；p5 面料功能图标行+产品信息（品牌占位、色卡五种、洗护图标、厚薄/弹力/版型/柔软指数条）+尺码表（码数110-160，胸围/衣长/袖长/肩宽）+年龄身高对照（3-14岁，身高90-150cm）；p6 尺码温馨提示+红棉服模特展示；p7 红色街拍大图+推荐搭配入口；p8 红色全身+内衬/短裙搭配卡；p9 玫红全身展示；p10 玫红多角度；p11 薄荷绿全身；p12 薄荷绿多角度；p13 浅紫全身；p14 浅紫多角度；p15 黑色花田场景；p16 黑色背面与侧身；p17 黑色三连展示。品类判定：产品为中长款连帽横绗棉服外套，外穿场景（街拍、书包、裙装搭配），尺码110-160对应身高90-150cm、年龄3-14岁，属童装外穿棉衣而非贴身内衣家居服，故判为 母婴/童装；源夹名「童装」与判定一致，不涉及母婴与内衣家居服易混对改判。已剥离：原品牌字样与占位LOGO大字、模特面容与身份（全部改为 generic child model 颈部以下/背影/手部）、原文案原句、聚酯纤维含量百分比、拉合测试次数等不可验证数值、洗护图标具体参数、尺码表实测数值与年龄体重数值、原平台店铺字样、推荐搭配的具体商品图；保留可复用的机位/光位/背景色板/信息图结构。17屏合并去重后收敛为11镜：多色街拍屏合并为变体与场景镜、纯装饰拼贴屏丢弃，provenance.sourceImageCount 仍为 17。
